candidates.title: UCL 22 Gordon Street reopened for The Bartlett
candidates.summary: UCL recorded that 22 Gordon Street, home of The Bartlett Faculty and The Bartlett School of Architecture, had been officially opened after construction works and later won a RIBA London award.
candidates.observed_change: A rebuilt and upgraded university architecture-school building entered official use in Bloomsbury.
candidates.source_name: 22 Gordon Street reopens and wins RIBA award

candidates.limitations: The event records official opening after refurbishment and extension; enabling works, phased occupation, awards, and later school operations are separate evidence paths.
